input.command:
cat > /tmp/opencode/bench/log-analysis-baseline/analyze.py <<'EOF'
import re, json, collections, statistics
pat = re.compile(r'^(\S+) (\w+) user=(\S+) route=(\S+) code=(\S+) latency=(\S+) msg="(.*)"$')
rows=[]; bad=[]
for i,line in enumerate(open('server.log', encoding='utf-8'),1):
    line=line.rstrip('\n')
    m=pat.match(line)
    if not m: bad.append((i,line)); continue
    ts,lvl,user,route,code,lat,msg=m.groups()
    lm=re.fullmatch(r'(-?\d+)ms', lat)
    rows.append(dict(ts=ts,lvl=lvl,user=user,route=route,code=code,lat=lat,latv=int(lm.group(1)) if lm else None,msg=msg))
print("bad lines:",len(bad))
for b in bad[:10]: print(b)
print("bad latency:", collections.Counter(r['lat'] for r in rows if r['latv'] is None))
print("levels:", collections.Counter(r['lvl'] for r in rows))
print("codes:", collections.Counter(r['code'] for r in rows).most_common())
print("routes:", collections.Counter(r['route'] for r in rows))
errs=[r for r in rows if r['lvl']=='ERROR']
print("ERROR count", len(errs))
print("ERROR codes", collections.Counter(r['code'] for r in errs).most_common())
ck=[r['latv'] for r in rows if r['route']=='/api/checkout']
print("checkout n",len(ck),"mean",sum(ck)/len(ck))
print("routes with checkout-like:", [x for x in collections.Counter(r['route'] for r in rows) if 'checkout' in x.lower()])
to=[r for r in rows if 'timeout' in r['msg'].lower()]
print("timeout lines",len(to),"users",len(set(r['user'] for r in to)))
print("timeout msg variants", collections.Counter(r['msg'] for r in to))
fat=[r for r in rows if r['lvl']=='FATAL']
print("fatal count",len(fat),"min ts",min(r['ts'] for r in fat),"first in file",fat[0]['ts'] if fat else None)
print("first fatal by file order ts", next(r['ts'] for r in rows if r['lvl']=='FATAL'))
print("ts monotonic?", all(rows[i]['ts']<=rows[i+1]['ts'] for i in range(len(rows)-1)))
print("ts dupes:", len(rows)-len(set(r['ts'] for r in rows)))
EOF
python3 analyze.py
